chk_routing_steps_target.name: chk_routing_steps_target
chk_routing_steps_target.value: (product_id IS NOT NULL AND bom_item_id IS NULL) OR (product_id IS NULL AND bom_item_id IS NOT NULL)

chk_inventory_receipt_items_target.name: chk_inventory_receipt_items_target
chk_inventory_receipt_items_target.value: (item_type = 'PRODUCT' AND product_id IS NOT NULL AND material_id IS NULL) OR (item_type = 'MATERIAL' AND material_id IS NOT NULL AND product_id IS NULL)

chk_inventory_issue_items_target.name: chk_inventory_issue_items_target
chk_inventory_issue_items_target.value: (item_type = 'PRODUCT' AND product_id IS NOT NULL AND material_id IS NULL) OR (item_type = 'MATERIAL' AND material_id IS NOT NULL AND product_id IS NULL)

chk_inventory_transactions_target.name: chk_inventory_transactions_target
chk_inventory_transactions_target.value: (item_type = 'PRODUCT' AND product_id IS NOT NULL AND material_id IS NULL) OR (item_type = 'MATERIAL' AND material_id IS NOT NULL AND product_id IS NULL)

chk_inventory_transactions_quantity_sign.name: chk_inventory_transactions_quantity_sign
chk_inventory_transactions_quantity_sign.value:
(type IN ('RECEIPT', 'TRANSFER_IN', 'PRODUCTION_IN', 'ADJUSTMENT_IN') AND quantity > 0)
          OR (type IN ('ISSUE', 'TRANSFER_OUT', 'PRODUCTION_OUT', 'ADJUSTMENT_OUT') AND quantity < 0)

chk_inventory_balances_target.name: chk_inventory_balances_target
chk_inventory_balances_target.value: (item_type = 'PRODUCT' AND product_id IS NOT NULL AND material_id IS NULL) OR (item_type = 'MATERIAL' AND material_id IS NOT NULL AND product_id IS NULL)

chk_production_orders_status_fields.name: chk_production_orders_status_fields
chk_production_orders_status_fields.value:
(status = 'PENDING' AND code IS NULL AND approved_at IS NULL)
          OR (status = 'APPROVED' AND code IS NOT NULL AND approved_at IS NOT NULL)

chk_production_job_bom_items_item_type_t.name: chk_production_job_bom_items_item_type_target
chk_production_job_bom_items_item_type_t.value: (item_type = 'PRODUCT' AND product_id IS NOT NULL AND material_id IS NULL) OR (item_type = 'MATERIAL' AND material_id IS NOT NULL AND product_id IS NULL)

chk_production_job_materials_qty.name: chk_production_job_materials_qty
chk_production_job_materials_qty.value: (unit_qty IS NULL OR unit_qty > 0) AND required_qty > 0
